[https://www.ehl.markets/]
Event Horizon Labs — AI research lab for the science of markets The AI lab for the science of markets. From algo trading to reasoning-driven investing. Event Horizon Labs 2026 We're a small team of researchers and engineers with deep experience in markets. Today, we're still in the loop with our agents, building one giant statistical machine for algorithmic trading. We've built institutional-grade infrastructure to form hypotheses, run experiments, and build profitable trading strategies. Our goal is to engineer ourselves out of the loop , so the machine runs end to end on agents and compounds its edge faster than any human-driven process. Toward that end we employ both quantitative researchers and AI researchers, working to understand automated research itself, as applied to markets. We're starting with markets partly because it's what we know, and partly because they might be the hardest test there is for AGI. They're an adversarial arena where the sum total of human knowledge and technology competes to predict what happens next. Markets are an evolutionary process, where any real insight is rewarded almost immediately and every edge gets competed away just as fast. The deeper we go, the more forecasting looks like the whole problem of intelligence , not a corner of it, and likely not something that stays confined to markets. We're hiring founding engineers to build the models, infrastructure, and systems that get us there. These are founding roles with competitive salary and meaningful equity. View founding roles → Incumbents scale headcount. We scale agents. We are a research lab where AI progress compounds directly into P&L. Team from Citadel , Jump Trading , Stanford , Caltech , Berkeley INVESTORS founders@ehl.markets WE'RE HIRING Founding research and infrastructure roles. View open roles →

[https://www.ehl.markets/careers.html]
Careers — Event Horizon Labs ← Back to home Build the research engine. We've kept the founding team small and the bar very high: PhD researchers and engineers who've published real work and shipped systems that run real money. You'd be in a room of people who are hard to keep up with, in the best way. We work in person in San Francisco, on founding roles with real equity, and you'd own a part of the system end to end. AI Research Engineer Quantitative Researcher Infrastructure Engineer FOUNDING ROLE AI Research Engineer You build the system that does our research: agents that form hypotheses, run experiments against markets, and learn from what comes back, plus the models that make them better over time. Right now that means rigorously studying how automated research applies to problems like objective-function design, and building a leaderboard where LLMs run agentic research to develop algorithmic strategies in a production-grade environment. We're working to take ourselves out of the loop, and most of the hard problems are still open. WHAT YOU'D DO Design the loop itself: evolutionary search in the spirit of AlphaEvolve, and agent orchestration for unbounded, autonomous research Train and improve the models that drive how the system reasons, evaluates, and decides Design the objective functions and rewards the agents optimize, so the system chases real progress instead of gaming the metric Turn what each run learns into knowledge the system compounds on, so it gets sharper over time YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF You have real depth in ML, as a researcher or an engineer (many of us have PhDs, but what you've built matters more than the credential) You can take a vague, open-ended problem and drive it to a working result on your own You're strong in Python and have trained models that made it into production You prefer fast loops and simple experiments to long solo efforts BONUS Experience with agents and LLM tool-use, reinforcement learning, or time-series modeling You've worked near markets, or another domain where the feedback is fast and unforgiving DETAILS Stack: Py
